name: Great Basin National Park
policyReason: Leashed pets may use the Lexington Arch Trail and the Baker to visitor center trail only.
summary: Leashed pets may use the Lexington Arch Trail and the Baker to visitor center trail only.

excerpts.quote: Leashed pets can only be exercised in the campgrounds, in front of the visitor centers, and along roads.
Pets are not allowed on any trails or backcountry areas.

dogRules.text: Allowed on Lexington Arch Trail and the Baker to Great Basin Visitor Center trail.
Not in Lehman Caves or at evening programs.
